profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Geico | ex-Tesla

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed integrations between disparate applications, enabling seamless data synchronization and ensuring smooth interoperability for enhanced system functionality
through the use of Kafka.
Constructed logic within transfer APIs in order to comply with new China laws, averting potential fines for the company.
Collaborated closely with UX designers to facilitate the creation of a new UI design by providing comprehensive explanations of the application's functionality and user flow,
ensuring alignment between design concepts and technical feasibility.
Redesigned user interface by developing and integrating new components to comply with modern style guidelines, boosting visual appeal and resulting in a 30% increase in
user satisfaction.
Enhanced and mainted a robust codebase for a high-traffic platform that supported on average 5,500 transactions per day.
Supported API improvements for an application handling 7,000 requests per second, enhancing performance and scalability to meet high-demand requirements.
Identified and addressed production issues with Splunk, swiftly devising effective solutions and documenting through Jira tickets, ensuring rapid resolution and minimizing
impact on system performance and user experience.
Ranked as the second top code reviewer for peer reviews among a team of 30 developers, demonstrating a commitment to maintaining code quality and fostering collaborative
improvement within the development team.
Mentored interns through code reviews, pair programming sessions, fostering skill development and knowledge sharing within the team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Optimized database queries and enhance user interface responsiveness, achieving a 99% increase in page performance and significantly elevating user satisfaction ratings.
Contributed in a 4-month migration initiative, transitioning from Wijmo Grid library to AG Grid enhancing performance and functionality within the application.
Consistently provided support to two teams through the development of bug fixes and UI enhancements.

positions.title: Marketing And Promotions Assistant
positions.description:
Marketing and Promotions coordinator for a two-week event that recognizes the accomplishments of different  engineer contributions 
Promoted event through writing ads for school newspaper and responsible for creating email blast to engineering students

honors.title: Most Technically Challenging Hack
honors.description: Created an app with my teammate at an all-female hackathon in North Carolina called PearlHacks. The app was called Glow which promotes people to being their brightest self through practicing self-care. We won most technically challenging hack because we were both beginners and were trying to use an Amazon API which was very time consuming (even with the help from mentors). We ended up not being able to go forth with implementing the Amazon API but was able to implement an API that generates random positive quotes.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Served free ice cream to kids with illnesses 
Served breakfast for families and helped walked them to their tables and assisted them in whatever they needed
Watched over families and kids as they were swimming in the pool and made sure everyone was safe 
Played with children by doing small arts and crafts with them

Renovated a school that was on the verge of closing down 
Scraped peeling paint off ceiling and re-painted walls
Reorganized entire library
Donated books and rugs

projects.title: Glow
projects.description: Created an iOS app with my teammate at an all-female hackathon in North Carolina called PearlHacks. The app was called Glow which promotes people to being their brightest self through practicing self-care. We focused on skincare since there are people that are unfamiliar on how to have a good skin regimen, which could potentially save tons of money from preventing going to the dermatologist for a problem that could have been easily solved.

projects.title: Casino Program
projects.description: Created a program where users can play poker or blackjack against a computer. Users can use this program if they want to relax and enjoy a game. This program can also be used to practice poker and blackjack skills without the actual commitment of losing money.
